records.source: I don't know you. Why are you talking to me?
records.translation: 我不認識你。為什麼要和我說話？

records.source: Oh, is it my birthday? I was hoping I'd forget.#$b#This is actually really nice, though. Thank you.$h
records.translation: 喔，今天是我的生日嗎？我還希望自己會忘記。#$b#不過這份禮物真的很棒。謝謝。$h

records.source: Oh, is it my birthday? That's right... I almost forgot. Thanks.
records.translation: 喔，今天是我的生日嗎？對喔……我差點忘了。謝謝。

records.source: I don't have to go into work today, so I'm not complaining...
records.translation: 我今天不用去上班，所以沒什麼好抱怨的……

records.source: Oh, there's some kind of weird weather today? I didn't notice.
records.translation: 喔，今天天氣有點怪？我沒注意到。

records.source: Heh... thanks. Tastes just like beer.
records.translation: 嘿……謝啦。味道就像啤酒。

records.source: Um... sure.#$e#I'd better stop eating...
records.translation: 呃……好啊。#$e#我最好別再吃了……

records.source: Oh, you made it? *squish*... Um... *smack*... I think I'll stick to frozen pizza. But thanks.
records.translation: 喔，這是你做的？*軟爛聲*……呃……*咂嘴*……我想還是吃冷凍披薩就好。不過謝啦。

records.source: Have you tried the new Joja Bubblerito? I ate two in one sitting yesterday, that was a mistake...
records.translation: 你吃過新出的 Joja 氣泡捲餅嗎？我昨天一口氣吃了兩個，那真是個錯誤……

records.source: I... wasn't really expecting this, after all I've put you through...
records.translation: 我……讓你經歷了那麼多，真的沒想到會有這一天……

records.source: I think I might be the luckiest guy in the world... $h
records.translation: 我大概是全世界最幸運的傢伙…… $h

records.source: Sorry you had to see me like that, @...$s
records.translation: 抱歉讓你看到我那副模樣，@……$s

records.source: I'm trying to cut back on the drinks... it's not going to be easy.
records.translation: 我正在試著少喝一點……這不會容易。

records.source: Buh... hope the bar's open.
records.translation: 唉……希望酒吧有開。

records.source: Welp... got my year's supply of Vitamin D. Now I can play video games with the blinds shut the rest of the year.
records.translation: 好啦……一整年份的維生素 D 都補足了。接下來一整年，我都能拉上百葉窗打電玩。

records.source: That's right... I'm not wearing any shoes or socks.#$b#Some call it a public health risk.#$b#The crabs seem to enjoy it, though.$h
records.translation: 沒錯……我既沒穿鞋，也沒穿襪子。#$b#有些人說這是公共衛生風險。#$b#不過螃蟹似乎很喜歡。$h

records.source: Hoo... Feels good to rest these hams.#$b#If anyone needs me, I'll just be sitting here, marinating.
records.translation: 呼……讓這兩條火腿休息一下真舒服。#$b#要是有人找我，我就坐在這裡慢慢醃著。

records.source: Phew... feels good to have a cold drink...#$e#Or maybe a few...
records.translation: 呼……喝杯冰涼的飲料真舒服……#$e#也許多喝幾杯……

records.source: Okay, this sand is piping hot. I regret not wearing shoes.$s
records.translation: 好吧，這沙子燙得要命。我後悔沒穿鞋了。$s

records.source: Dance? Hoo-boy. Okay... let me chug a few more of these first...
records.translation: 跳舞？老天。好吧……先讓我再灌幾杯……
……不要。$s

records.source: I heard you built Pam a house... That's really generous...#$b#You know, I could use a hundred thousand gold myself...#$e#*ahem* ...ah ...Just kidding. ...Heh.
records.translation: 聽說你替潘姆蓋了一棟房子……真慷慨……#$b#你知道，我自己也用得上十萬金幣……#$e#*清喉嚨*……啊……開玩笑的。……嘿。

records.source: I heard someone bought Pam a house... *sigh*... What did Pam ever do to earn that kind of generosity??
records.translation: 聽說有人送了潘姆一棟房子……*嘆氣*……潘姆到底做過什麼，值得別人如此慷慨？？

records.source: ...$a#$e#...Leave me alone.$a
*gulp* Oh... Yeah, okay... I guess I should've seen this coming.$s#$b#I'll... uh... guess I'll see you at the Saloon.
records.translation: *吞嚥* 喔……嗯，好吧……我想自己早該料到。$s#$b#我會……呃……大概會在酒館見到你。

records.source: %Shane has a glazed look in his eye. He won't speak to you.
records.translation: %Shane眼神呆滯。他不願和你說話。

records.source: I don't understand you... *sigh*...
records.translation: 我不懂你……*嘆氣*……

records.source: I hardly know you. Why are you talking to me?||What's the point of talking to me? I don't want any friends.
records.translation: 我幾乎不認識你。為什麼要和我說話？||和我說話有什麼意義？我不想交任何朋友。

records.source: Hey. Sorry if I came off as rude when we first met.#$e#It takes me a while to warm up to strangers.||It's a lot of effort to be friends with someone. It's easier to just be alone.
records.translation: 嘿。我們剛認識時，如果我顯得很沒禮貌，抱歉。#$e#我需要一點時間才能對陌生人敞開心扉。||和別人交朋友要花很多心力。一個人待著輕鬆多了。

records.source: I'll be honest, I still can't understand why you'd want to be friends with me.||Life isn't fair, and I can't help but feel bitter about it.
records.translation: 老實說，我還是不明白你為什麼想和我交朋友。||人生並不公平，我忍不住對此感到怨恨。

records.source: Do you ever feel like the whole world is scrutinizing you like some disgusting insect?
records.translation: 你是否曾覺得全世界都把你當成某種噁心的昆蟲仔細打量？

records.source: What? What do you want? Go away.
records.translation: 什麼？你想怎樣？走開。

records.source: What do you want from me? Money? I'd give you a pot of gold to leave me alone!
records.translation: 你想從我這裡得到什麼？錢嗎？只要你別煩我，我願意給你一鍋黃金！

records.source: Every time I try something new it goes horribly wrong. You learn to just stay in a shell.
records.translation: 每次嘗試新事物，結果都糟糕透頂。久而久之，就學會躲在殼裡。

records.source: Life isn't so bad... at least I have frozen pizza and eggs.$u
records.translation: 人生沒有那麼糟……至少我還有冷凍披薩和雞蛋。$u

records.source: We should go to a Tunnelers game some time. When I go by myself, I usually drink way too much beer.
records.translation: 我們有空應該去看隧道隊的比賽。我自己去時，通常會喝太多啤酒。

records.source: I need to keep it together for Jas' sake. I don't want to be a bad role model for her.||I'm kind of like a father figure to Jas. I just hope I haven't let her down too much.$s
records.translation: 為了賈斯，我必須振作起來。我不想成為她的壞榜樣。||我有點像賈斯的父親。只希望自己沒有讓她太失望。$s

records.source: No, I don't have time to chat with you.
records.translation: 不，我沒時間和你聊天。

records.source: I guess I've grown attached to Marnie and Jas. We're a ragtag bunch but it kind of feels like a weird family.#$e#I never really had much of a family as a kid.$s
records.translation: 我想自己已經對瑪妮和賈斯產生感情了。我們是一群雜牌軍，卻有點像個古怪的家庭。#$e#我小時候其實沒什麼家人。$s

records.source: $d Joja#*sigh* ...Every day is the same. Stocking those horrible shelves, going to the saloon, tossing and turning all night.$s|I hated my job at JojaMart, but now that I'm unemployed I feel even worse.$s
records.translation: $d Joja#*嘆氣*……每天都一模一樣。替那些可怕的貨架補貨、去酒館，然後整夜輾轉難眠。$s|我討厭在 Joja 超市的工作，但現在失業了，感覺反而更糟。$s

records.source: What do you want? Leave me alone.
records.translation: 你想怎樣？別煩我。

records.source: You're really persistent. I guess I'm just surprised that anyone would be interested in talking to me.
records.translation: 你真的很執著。我只是很驚訝，竟然有人會有興趣和我說話。

records.source: Buh... Where's the Joja Cola?||Why try? Life's just a roll of the dice.#$e#When they rolled mine, the dice fell off the table.
records.translation: 唉……Joja 可樂在哪裡？||為什麼要努力？人生不過是擲骰子。#$e#輪到我時，骰子掉到桌子外面了。

records.source: You like talking to me? I guess I believe you... maybe you're as weird as I am.$h
records.translation: 你喜歡和我說話？我想我相信你……也許你和我一樣奇怪。$h

records.source: Don't you have work to do?
records.translation: 你沒有工作要做嗎？

records.source: %Shane's hard at work. He doesn't seem interested in talking.
records.translation: %Shane正在努力工作。他似乎沒興趣說話。

records.source: $d Joja#What's the point of life if all you do is work?|I haven't been able to pay my rent, but Marnie's letting me stay anyway. I'm lucky.
records.translation: $d Joja#如果人生只剩下工作，還有什麼意義？|我一直付不起房租，但瑪妮還是讓我住下來。我很幸運。

records.source: I'll definitely be going to the saloon tonight. What else is there to do?
records.translation: 我今晚肯定會去酒館。不然還能做什麼？

records.source: Buh... Can you imagine how disgusting my liver must look?$s#$e#My body feels twenty years older than it should...$s
records.translation: 唉……你能想像我的肝臟看起來有多噁心嗎？$s#$e#我的身體感覺比實際年齡老了二十歲……$s

records.source: My body hurts a lot less since I cut back on the booze.#$e#But it still feels like I'm always teetering on the edge...$s
records.translation: 減少喝酒後，我的身體沒那麼痛了。#$e#但還是覺得自己總在懸崖邊搖搖欲墜……$s

records.source: Why are you bothering me? I want to be alone.
records.translation: 為什麼要來煩我？我想一個人待著。

records.source: #$1 ShaneJOSH#I'm surprised that you're still trying to make friends with me. Haven't I been rude enough to you yet?#$e#*sigh*...$s
records.translation: #$1 ShaneJOSH#沒想到你還在試著和我交朋友。我對你還不夠無禮嗎？#$e#*嘆氣*……$s

records.source: $d Joja#I'm renting my room from Marnie at a really good price. It's small but I can't complain.|If I could reset my life maybe I'd start a chicken farm. Only free-range eggs of course.
records.translation: $d Joja#我用很優惠的價格向瑪妮租房間。雖然很小，但沒什麼好抱怨的。|如果能重啟人生，我也許會開一座養雞場。當然只生產放養雞蛋。

records.source: I've really grown attached to Marnie's chickens.$h||A chicken will never let you down. Humans, on the other hand...
records.translation: 我真的很喜歡瑪妮的雞。$h||雞永遠不會讓你失望。至於人類……

records.source: Your farm seems like a great place to raise chickens.$h
records.translation: 你的農場似乎很適合養雞。$h

records.source: I'm busy, can't you tell?||...I don't feel like talking to anyone.
records.translation: 我很忙，你看不出來嗎？||……我不想和任何人說話。

records.source: You again? How many times do I have to tell you to leave me alone?$s
records.translation: 又是你？我要說多少次別來煩我？$s

records.source: Hmm... it's %time. Should I throw a frozen pizza in the microwave, or should I wait?$u||If the Tunnelers win, I'll knock back a cold one to celebrate.#$e#If they lose? I'll have a cold one to drown my sorrows.
records.translation: 嗯……已經%time了。該把冷凍披薩丟進微波爐，還是再等等？$u||如果隧道隊贏了，我會喝杯冰啤酒慶祝。#$e#如果輸了？那就喝杯冰啤酒借酒澆愁。

records.source: ...I think I might be gaining weight.$s
records.translation: ……我覺得自己可能變胖了。$s

records.source: If I watch more TV maybe I can forget about life. That would be relaxing.$u
records.translation: 多看點電視，也許就能忘記人生。那應該很放鬆。$u

records.source: Hi, @. I've actually been having a pretty good day so far.$h
records.translation: 嗨，@。其實我今天到目前為止過得挺不錯。$h

records.source: Okay... that'll require a great script. Maybe I'll ask Elliott for advice next time I see him at the saloon.$s
records.translation: 好吧……那需要一份很棒的劇本。下次在酒館見到艾利歐特時，也許可以請他給點建議。$s

records.source: Sounds great. I'll have to create a bunch of practical effects to make it look cool.
records.translation: 聽起來很棒。我得製作一堆實體特效，才能讓它看起來很酷。

records.source: I didn't know you were such a miser...$s
records.translation: 我不知道你這麼小氣……$s

records.source: Okay, Dad...$s^Okay, Mom...$s
records.translation: 好啦，爸爸……$s^好啦，媽媽……$s

records.source: Oh, wow...$s
records.translation: 喔，哇……$s

records.source: ...Yeah, me too.
records.translation: ……對，我也是。

records.source: I know... that's why I stopped by, to tell you about it.
records.translation: 我知道……所以才過來告訴你這件事。

records.source: Wow, it was that serious, huh? I can hardly remember...
records.translation: 哇，事情有那麼嚴重嗎？我幾乎不記得了……

records.source: Oh yeah? I guess that makes sense.$6#$b#Me? I get bored with Pelican Town sometimes.#$b#But... I like that you're different. We balance each other out.$l
records.translation: 是嗎？我想這很合理。$6#$b#我嗎？有時候我也會厭倦鵜鶘鎮。#$b#不過……我喜歡你的與眾不同。我們能互相平衡。$l

records.source: Oh really? I'm surprised... Didn't you move to Stardew Valley to escape the noise of the city?$6#$b#I mean... Don't get me wrong, I totally understand. My life in Pelican Town is pretty bland, you know.
records.translation: 真的嗎？真讓我意外……你搬來星露谷，不就是為了逃離城市的喧囂嗎？$6#$b#我的意思是……別誤會，我完全能理解。你知道，我在鵜鶘鎮的生活相當乏味。
